For `undefined` (and function/symbol values), `JSON.stringify` returns `undefined`, so `.replace` throws a TypeError. Object entries at line 316 and array elements at line 310 recursively pass such values into this base case, so an explicitly undefined optional property or array element crashes `canonicalReview`/`reviewDigest` instead of canonicalizing consistently with `JSON.stringify` semantics.
